independentWorks.title: Radical Reduction in Computing Costs with AI-powered Predictive Memory Technology
independentWorks.readRange: PDF pp20,22,23,39; p22 diagram visually inspected
independentWorks.mechanism: Cold pages move to Flash; misses pull pages while predictions push related pages into DRAM before demand. Linux driver, ensemble prediction engine and observability are distinct components.
independentWorks.boundary: Conference presentation of team technology, not sole invention; implementation details and independent performance not established. 100ns label is local DRAM read, not Flash latency. FMS and later MEXT talks are same project, not extra independent works.

independentWorks.title: High availability systems having thinly-provisioned secondary servers
independentWorks.mechanism: A thinly provisioned secondary maintains database state; on primary failure spare powered/booted nodes expand actual allocation through resource mapping without guest OS disruption.
independentWorks.boundary: Patent disclosure, not evidence of commercial implementation or measured recovery time; preserve co-inventor attribution and non-AMD assignee.

editorialDiagnostic: Predictive paging requires lead time greater than fetch/queue delay without intolerable bandwidth or cache pollution; HA expansion requires ready spares and state consistency within recovery objective.
publication: Pending catalog integration; no deployed claim.
